title: Quiet and easy
review_text: This mower is quiet and easy to push on my small yard.

title: Battery wish
review_text: I wish the battery indicator showed remaining runtime before my half acre is finished.

title: Would not start
review_text: It would not start and customer service kept me waiting for parts.

title: Poor cut
review_text: The mower leaves stragglers and needs multiple passes in thick grass.

title: Not quiet
review_text: It is not quiet but the self propelled speed works well on hills.

title: Gas replacement
review_text: I replaced my gas mower and love the same battery as my other tools.

title: Charger failed
review_text: The charger failed and the battery does not last on my large yard.

title: Good bagging
review_text: Bagging and mulching work well after rain.

title: App request
review_text: Please add a mobile app with maintenance reminders.
